prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 二维合并 · 采购评审 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "甲、乙两家报价接近，建议进入第二轮商务谈判，重点" spans 1 col × 2 row; "未按要求提交完整报价文件，视为无效投标" spans 3 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "供应商" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "报价" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 65px
  col 3: header "交期" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 38px
  col 4: header "质保" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "评审意见" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 582px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 441px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 440px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较三家供应商的采购报价、交期和质保，并记录评审结论。","reading":"读者先按供应商横向查看条件，再纵向比较甲、乙两家的数值；共享意见将两家联系起来，丙家的合并单元格说明其投标无效。","groups":["报价、交期和质保是可并列比较的采购条件，列宽应足以让有效报价及单位保持完整。","供应商与评审意见分别承担行标识和结论说明的作用；意见列需要较多空间容纳连续文字。"],"keep_intact":["供应商名称","金额及货币符号","交期和质保的数字与单位","简短结论“淘汰”"],"may_wrap":["甲、乙两家共享的长评审意见可自然换行，其高度由两行共同承担。","丙家横跨报价、交期和质保三列的无效投标说明可自然换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [67, 86, 59, 52, 176] · table 441×203px · row heights [36, 53, 53, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [67, 100, 73, 70, 130] · table 441×249px · row heights [36, 76, 76, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [91, 86, 59, 52, 152] · table 441×226px · row heights [36, 65, 65, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"供应商、金额和采购条件均保持完整；共享评审意见的四行文字清晰，甲、乙两行的高度也较均衡。","problems":"丙家的无效投标说明末尾单独留下较短的一行，说明与右侧“淘汰”的横向联系略显松散。","cause":"报价、交期和质保三列合计197px，横跨这三列的说明需要换行；意见列176px则给共享意见提供了较宽的阅读空间。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"采购条件列宽松，金额、数字及单位容易辨认；丙家的合并说明有较多横向空间。","problems":"共享意见被切成六行，甲、乙两行因此明显增高，意见文字呈狭长条状，削弱了横向比较的紧凑性。","cause":"报价、交期和质保三列合计243px，挤占了意见列，使其仅有130px。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"金额和采购条件保持完整；共享意见仍能连续阅读，供应商名称也有充足空间。","problems":"供应商列显得过宽，共享意见比r0A多一行，甲、乙两行随之增高；丙家的说明仍需换行。","cause":"供应商列为91px，比容纳名称所需宽度多出较多空间；意见列因此缩至152px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"refine-A","widths":[67,86,59,52,176],"change":"以r0A为基准保留：各项数据完整，共享意见的宽度和行高在现有方案中最协调，供新方案直接比较。"},{"name":"wider-opinion","widths":[62,86,59,52,181],"change":"将供应商列缩至仍能容纳名称的62px，把5px让给意见列，测试共享意见的换行是否更从容。"},{"name":"balanced-merge","widths":[67,86,59,55,173],"change":"从意见列移3px给质保列，稍微拓宽丙家跨三列的说明，同时观察共享意见能否保持四行。"}]}
